content: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Virtue is its own intrinsic compensation. Practicing honesty, courage, and love elevates the soul immediately, independent of external prizes.
practicalInsight: Live with uncompromising honor today, knowing that nobility of character is the highest possible prize.
reflectionPrompt: How does living with integrity immediately reward your internal sense of peace?
